card.name: Dosing text for ESA and blood-product drugs
card.fires_on: Small linking or spacing tokens (to, of, Weekly, a space after a comma) inside ESA dosing and conversion text, such as epoetin, darbepoetin, Mircera and Nplate. Also partway through names like Nplate, ABO and Transfusion.

modes.label: Linking word in ESA switching
modes.description: Words like to, of or Weekly right before or between ESA drug names in dose-conversion text.
modes.example: when switching from another ESA<< to>> Mircera.

modes.label: Space after statistics comma
modes.description: A space after a comma inside a hazard ratio or confidence interval.

modes.label: Inside blood-related names
modes.description: Partway through names like Nplate, ABO or Transfusion.
modes.example: The determination of a patient's<< A>>BO and Rh blood type

card.writes: It pushes against blood and plasma words, so the next word is less likely to be a blood or serum term.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in anemia-drug dosing and conversion text, just before a drug name or number comes next.
